full_judgment: 10. The High Court Division observed that the plaintiffs did not file their documents of title and, thereby, failed to prove their title and possession over the suit land. It was further observed upon perusal of the L.C.R that the plaintiffs produced a copy of the C.S. Khatian No. 256 as Exhibit- 1, but the suit land is of C.S. Khatian No. 258 and no other documents were exhibited by the plaintiffs although reference was made in the plaint to a Pattannama and various kabala deeds. The High Court Division held that as the plaintiffs failed to produce the documents in support of their alleged title to the suit land, it must be held that the suit land is the khas land of the Government as per the admitted S.A. and R.S. record. As such the High Court Division disregarded the admission of D.W. 2 with reference to possession by the plaintiffs.
